title: Reuse ladder instructions
description: The instructions of the probe of the rules that ask whether the code needed to be written at all: its task, the review, those rules, and the checkout

task.description: What this probe does, said to the probe itself
task.const: Probe the pull request in review against every rule in rulebook.rules and write one row per rule to the file named in review.ledger. These rules ask whether the code needed to be written at all: search the repository at checkout, the web, and anywhere else the question leads. Research on the web is required

rulebook.instructions: Apply each rule with its [[term]]s as definitions defines them. When the application of a rule is in doubt, its parent in principles decides

rules.id: No new code where an external tool serves
rules.body: Write [[New code]] when an [[External tool or service]] meets the need.

principles.parent: Code is a liability, not an asset
principles.body: Keep the [[Development Stack]] small and well known.

definitions.specification: Meeting the need by writing new code.
Meeting the need by integrating an existing external tool or calling an existing service.
The ways to meet a need, in order of how little code we own afterwards.
